item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "I saw it as an opportunity and lifted the land transaction permit zone"... Jung Won-oh: "That's an admission you took a risk without proper consideration" (오세훈 “기회로구나, 토허제 풀어”…정원오 “고민 않고 모험했다는 자인”)
item.description:
Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, stated on the 11th regarding last year's lifting and subsequent reimposition of the land transaction permit zone in Gangnam: "It was a one- to two-month hiccup." (오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 지난해 강남권 토지거래허가구역을 해제했다가 재지정한 것에 대해 “한두달 정도의 해프닝”이라고 11일 말했다.)

During a debate hosted by the Korea Broadcasting Journalists' Club at MBN Media Center, the candidate described the lifting and reimposition of the land transaction permit zone last year as "my only real estate blunder." (오 후보는 이날 엠비엔(MBN)미디어센터에서 열린 한국방송기자클럽 토론회에서 지난해 토허제 해제와 재지정에 대해 “제 유일한 부동산 실책”이라고 밝혔다.)

He explained: "At the time, the decision to lift the land transaction permit zone in Gangnam came when an analysis report indicated that the market was cooling excessively. I thought, 'If we lift it for Jamsamdaecheong (Jamsil in Songpa-gu, and Samseong, Daechi, Cheongdam in Gangnam-gu), now is the perfect opportunity,' and acted on that judgment. However, the market reacted very sensitively, and within just over a month, we restored it. Thanks to that, housing prices fell again." (그는 “당시 강남지역 토지거래허가 구역을 해제한 것은 ‘지나치게 싸늘하게 식어간다’는 분석보고서가 나올 때였다”며 “거기에 민감하게 대응하기 위해 ‘잠삼대청’(송파구 잠실, 강남구 삼성·대치·청담)을 푼다면 지금이 기회로구나' 하고 판단해서 풀었다. 그런데 시장이 굉장히 민감하게 대응해 불과 한 달 남짓 반에 원상복구를 했고, 그 덕분에 다시 (집값이) 떨어졌다”고 했다.)

Oh further claimed: "They are politically attacking me as if I am solely responsible for the continued failure of housing policies. Citizens will surely remember." (오 후보는 그러면서 “마치 지금까지 이어지는 부동산 정책 실패의 원인이 저한테 있는 것처럼 정치적인 공격을 하고 있다. 시민 여러분은 다 기억하고 계실 것”이라고 주장했다.)

In response, the election campaign committee of Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, issued a statement criticizing: "At that time, due to Oh's incompetence, housing supply in Seoul had plummeted. By lifting the land transaction permit zone in Gangnam—where expectations and pent-up demand were concentrated—housing price increases in Gangnam hit a seven-year high within a month. The outcome was that, amid the government's concerns at the time, Oh reversed his decision within a month and actually expanded the zone to a wider area." The statement added, "Oh dismissing this as a hiccup is no different from admitting he took a risk without properly considering even basic risks." (이에 정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보 선거대책위원회는 논평을 내어 “당시 오 후보의 무능으로 서울 주택공급이 급감한 상황에서, 기대 심리와 대기 수요가 몰려있는 강남권 토허구역을 해제해 한달 만에 강남 집값 상승률이 7년 만에 최고치를 찍었다”며 “당시 정부의 우려에 오 후보가 한달 만에 결정을 번복하고 오히려 더 넓은 지역으로 토허구역을 확장한 것이 이 사태의 결말”이라고 반박했다. 그러면서 “오 후보가 이걸 해프닝으로 치부하는 것은, 상식 수준의 리스크도 제대로 고민해보지 않고 모험을 했다는 자인이나 다름없다”고 덧붙였다. )

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Kim Yong-nam apologizes: 'Sewol special committee is a waste of tax money' remark 'hurt the bereaved families' (김용남 “‘세월호 특조위 세금 낭비’ 발언 유가족에 상처” 사과)
item.description:
Kim Yong-nam, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the by-election for the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul National Assembly seat, apologized for his past remarks calling the April 16 Sewol Ferry Disaster Special Investigation Committee a "waste of tax money," stating, "Regardless of my intention, I acknowledge that those comments left an indelible wound on the hearts of the bereaved families." He also referred to his experience serving as a spokesperson for Yoon Seok-yeol, the People Power Party presidential candidate during the 21st presidential election, as a "mistake." (김용남 더불어민주당 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거 후보가 과거 4·16 세월호 참사 특별조사위원회를 가리켜 “세금 낭비”라고 한 자신의 말에 대해 “제 의도와 상관없이 그 발언이 유가족분들의 가슴에 지울 수 없는 상처를 남겼음을 인정한다”며 사과했다. 21대 대선 때 윤석열 국민의힘 대통령 후보 캠프 대변인으로 활동한 경력에 대해서도 “과오”라고 했다.)

Candidate Kim issued this apology on Facebook on the 11th in a post titled "I sincerely apologize for my shortcomings." He wrote, "First, I bow my head and apologize to the bereaved families of the Sewol ferry disaster," adding, "At the time, I failed to fully grasp how deeply my remarks would wound the hearts of those who lost their beloved children and families. Before that pain, which nothing in the world can fully comfort, my words were far too immature." He continued, "My belief that the bereaved families deserve an exhaustive investigation without any taboo zones and generous support has remained unchanged since right after the disaster, and it still does. However, I was immature in that my expression of my views regarding the activities of the Sewol Special Committee created room for misunderstanding." <<> In a 2015 radio interview while serving as a lawmaker for the Saenuri Party, Candidate Kim had said, "It is urgent to review the budget for the Sewol Special Committee, which has been virtually wasting taxpayers' money without doing anything throughout its entire activity period," and "The Special Committee has almost filled its 120-member roster with people who have past so-called activist experience or are involved in that scene, and now they absurdly plan to investigate the president's seven-hour whereabouts on the day of the Sewol sinking." <<> Meanwhile, Candidate Kim also clarified his stance on serving as a spokesperson for the Yoon Seok-yeol campaign during the 21st presidential election. He wrote, "The bond from working together as prosecutors about 20 years ago, and the memories from that time, clouded my judgment. However, after realizing the truth, I have been at the forefront, grabbing the microphone and focusing on exposing the misdeeds of the Yoon Seok-yeol administration." He added, "Especially faced with this insurrection crisis, I have raised my voice decisively. From immediately after the declaration of martial law, my stance—that 'this is clearly an insurrection, and Yoon Seok-yeol must be punished and impeached as the ringleader of this insurrection'—has been no different from the democratic and progressive bloc by even an inch. My shouting louder than anyone else for the necessity of impeachment was, perhaps, a desperate effort to wash away my mistake of having been with him, even briefly." <<> He continued, "The fact that I served as a spokesperson for the Yoon Seok-yeol presidential campaign will remain a major stain on my life, but I will never deny or try to erase it. I will take that mistake as a painful lesson and, spending the rest of my political life with you, take the lead and devote myself to making the Republic of Korea a stronger bastion of democracy." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김 후보는 11일 페이스북에 ‘저의 부족함에 대해 깊이 사과드립니다’라는 제목의 글을 올려 이렇게 사과했다. 그는 “먼저 세월호 유가족분들께 고개 숙여 사죄드린다”며 “당시 제 발언이 사랑하는 자식과 가족을 잃은 유가족분들의 가슴에 얼마나 깊은 상처를 남길지 충분히 헤아리지 못했다. 세상 그 무엇으로도 온전히 위로할 수 없는 그 아픔 앞에, 제 표현은 너무나 미숙했다”고 했다. 이어 “유가족분들께 성역 없는 진상 규명과 아낌없는 지원이 당연히 이뤄져야 한다는 생각에는 참사 직후부터 변함이 없었고 지금도 마찬가지이지만, 세월호 특조위의 활동과 관련한 저의 뜻을 전달하는 데 있어서 오해의 소지를 만들었다는 점에서 미숙했다”고 적었다.)

item.title: [Breaking News] Wi Sung-lac "Namuho Attack Strongly Condemned...Identifying the Perpetrator and Taking Action" ([속보] 위성락 “나무호 피격, 강력 규탄…공격 주체 찾아내 조치”)
item.description:
National Security Advisor Wi Sung-lac stated on the 11th regarding the fire on the HMM NAMUHO being an "external attack," saying, "Our government's position is that attacks on civilian vessels like the NAMUHO cannot be justified or tolerated, and we strongly condemn this." (위성락 국가안보실장이 11일 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호의 화재가 ‘외부공격’으로 드러난 데 대해 “우리 정부는 나무호 등 민간 선박에 대한 공격은 정당화되거나 용납될 수 없다는 입장으로서 이를 강력히 규탄한다”고 말했다.)

During a briefing at the Blue House, Advisor Wi said, "Through additional investigation, we intend to identify the perpetrator, the exact type of aircraft, and its physical dimensions," adding, "We will consider necessary responses and measures accordingly." (위 실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “우리는 추가 조사를 통해 공격 주체, 정확한 기종, 물리적 크기를 식별해 나가고자 한다”며 “거기에 따른 필요한 대응과 조치를 고려해 나갈 것”이라고 밝혔다.)

Advisor Wi further stated, "We will continuously communicate with relevant countries to prevent recurrence and redouble efforts to enhance the safety of all our crew and vessels in the (nearby) strait," and "We will join international efforts to ensure the safety and free passage of all vessels, including ours." (위 실장은 이어 “사건이 재발하지 않도록 유관국과도 지속적으로 소통하고, (인근) 해협에 위치한 우리 모든 선원과 선박의 안전을 강화하기 위한 노력을 배가해 나갈 것”이라며 “우리를 포함한 모든 선박의 안전 보장, 자유로운 통항을 위한 국제사회 노력에 동참하겠다”고 말했다.)

The previous day, Ministry of Foreign Affairs Spokesperson Park Il announced, "Following a precise on-site investigation, CCTV review, and captain interview, it was determined that at 3:30 PM local time on the 4th, two unidentified aircraft struck the port side ballast tank plating of the HMM NAMUHO's stern twice, approximately one minute apart." (전날 박일 외교부 대변인은 “정밀한 현장조사, 시시티브이(CCTV) 확인 및 선장 면담 결과 4일 오후 3시30분(현지시각) 미상의 비행체 2기가 에이치엠엠 나무호 선미 좌현 평형수 탱크 외판을 약 1분 간격으로 두 차례 타격했다”고 밝혔다.)

The Blue House is cautious about naming a specific country as the perpetrator. A high-ranking Blue House official said, "We are not identifying the perpetrator at this time and are working to (uncover the cause)," adding, "It's difficult to say we will act based on preconceptions or premature conclusions. Once we have a determination, we will respond with an appropriate level of measures. The response will likely not differ significantly from what other countries would do in similar situations." (청와대는 공격 주체로 특정 국가가 거론되는 데 신중한 반응이다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “지금 공격 주체를 특정하지 않고, (원인을 밝히는 데) 노력하고 있다”며 “그때까지 예단을 갖거나 미리 단정해서 조치하겠다고 말하긴 어렵고, 판단이 서는 대로 거기에 맞는 적절한 수위에 따라 대처하겠다. 대처는 상식적으로 다른 나라들이 유사한 상황에 하는 대처와 크게 다르지 않을 것”이라고 말했다.)

Initially, our government had a high suspicion that the NAMUHO was attacked, but Advisor Wi Sung-lac adopted a cautious stance on the 6th, stating, "We cannot be certain it was an attack. There was no flooding or listing of the vessel." Regarding this, the high-ranking Blue House official explained, "Previously, we had not received reports of a breach, and it was difficult to make an overall judgment. It wasn't that we made a wrong judgment; we thought it appropriate to conduct a thorough investigation before making a decision." (애초 우리 정부는 나무호가 피격 가능성을 높게 판단했지만, 위성락 실장은 지난 6일 “피격을 확신할 수 없다. 일단 침수라든지 배가 기울어졌다거나 기울어짐은 없었다”며 신중한 태도를 보여왔다. 이를 두고 청와대 고위 관계자는 “지난번에는 파공이 있었다는 보고를 받지 못했고, 전체적으로 판단을 내리기가 어려웠다”며 “판단을 잘못 내린 것은 아니고, 정밀한 조사를 한 후에 판단하는 게 맞겠다고 생각한 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reported by Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr 심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Government Cautious… Experts: “Iran Could Have Accidentally Attacked the HMM Naju” (정부는 신중…전문가들 “이란, 나무호 우발적 공격 가능성”)
item.description:
The government has confirmed that the HMM Naju, a South Korean vessel anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, was attacked twice by unidentified flying objects, but it has refrained from identifying the perpetrator, maintaining a cautious stance. (정부는 호르무즈해협에 정박중이던 한국 선박 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호가 외부 비행체의 두차례 공격을 받은 것으로 확인했지만, 공격 주체를 특정하지 않고 신중한 태도를 유지하고 있다.)

National Security Office Director Suh Hoon stated at a briefing at the Blue House on the 11th, “Our government’s position is that attacks on civilian vessels like the Naju cannot be justified or tolerated, and we strongly condemn this act.” However, a high-ranking official at the Blue House emphasized, “We are not currently identifying the perpetrator. We are in the process of making that determination.” This indicates that the government aims to secure clear evidence through a detailed investigation of the debris from the flying object’s engine recovered from the ship. The reason is that officially naming a specific country at this stage could cause significant diplomatic repercussions. (위성락 국가안보실장은 11일 청와대 브리핑에서 “우리 정부는 나무호 등 민간 선박에 대한 공격은 정당화하거나 용납될 수 없다는 입장으로 이를 강력히 규탄한다”고 말했다. 다만, 청와대 고위관계자는 “지금 공격의 주체를 특정하지 않고 있다. 특정을 위한 노력을 하고 있는 단계”라고 강조했다. 선박에서 수거된 비행체 엔진 잔해에 대한 정밀 조사를 통해 명확한 증거를 확보하겠다는 것이다. 지금 정부가 공식적으로 특정 국가를 지목할 경우 외교적 파장이 너무 크기 때문이다.)

Experts familiar with the situation in Iran are focusing on the possibility that Iran’s Revolutionary Guard might have carried out an accidental attack, based on the circumstances revealed so far. (이란 상황에 정통한 전문가들은 현재까지 공개된 정황을 근거로 이란 혁명수비대가 우발적 공격을 했을 가능성에 주목한다.)

Yoon Kang-hyun, a former ambassador to Iran, said, “It appears to be an attack by Iran’s Revolutionary Guard, but it does not seem to be a deliberate targeting of a Korean ship.” Former Ambassador Yoon explained, “Iran is trying to strengthen its control over the Strait of Hormuz by requiring ships to obtain its approval to use the ‘designated shipping lanes’ close to its territorial waters. At the time of the incident, our ships were gathered on the side of the United Arab Emirates, opposite to Iran’s ‘designated shipping lanes,’ and were attacked there. The Iranian military operates as a decentralized organization not fully controlled by the central government, so local commanders may have acted on their own judgment and targeted ships moving outside of their control.” He added, “South Korea has not withdrawn its embassy in Iran, has sent a special envoy, and the foreign ministers of both countries have been in communication. Iran has no reason to specifically target a South Korean ship.” He also noted that ships linked to Qatar, France, and China were also attacked around the same time as the Naju. (윤강현 전 주이란대사는 “이란 혁명수비대의 공격으로 보이지만 한국 배를 겨냥한 의도적 공격은 아닌 것으로 보인다”고 말했다. 윤 전 대사는 “이란은 선박들이 자국의 승인을 받아 이란쪽 영해에 가까운 ‘지정 항로’로 다니게 해 호르무즈해협 통제권을 강화하려 하고 있는데, 사건 당시 우리 선박들은 이란 ‘지정 항로’의 반대편인 아랍에미리트 쪽에 모여 있다가 공격을 받았다”며 “이란 군은 중앙정부가 통제하지 않는 분권형 조직으로 움직이고 있고 현장에서 각자 판단해 통제권 밖에서 움직이는 배들을 겨냥했을 것”이라고 분석했다. 이어 “한국은 주이란한국대사관도 철수시키지 않고 특사도 보냈고 양국 외교 장관끼리 소통도 계속해왔는데 이란이 한국 배를 특별히 겨냥할 이유가 없다”면서 나무호가 공격 받은 전후에 카타르, 프랑스, 중국 관련 선박들도 공격을 받은 점에도 주목했다.)

Professor Yoo Dal-seung of the Department of Persian and Iranian Studies at Hankuk University of Foreign Studies also said, “There is a possibility of an unexpected provocation by a local commander of Iran’s Revolutionary Guard.” The attack on the Naju occurred on the 4th, which was when the U.S. launched the ‘Freedom Project’ operation, initiating a reverse blockade of the Strait of Hormuz. Commanders feeling pressured by this may have carried out an unexpected attack. (유달승 한국외국어대 교수(페르시아·이란학과)도 “이란 혁명수비대의 현장 지휘관에 의한 돌발적인 도발이었을 가능성이 있다”고 말했다. 나무호가 공격을 받은 지난 4일은 미국이 ‘해방 프로젝트(프로젝트 프리덤)’ 작전을 시작하면서 호르무즈해협 역봉쇄에 나섰던 때이고, 이에 압박을 느낀 지휘관들이 돌발적으로 공격을 했다는 것이다.)

Nevertheless, experts argue that if the attack is confirmed to be by Iran, the government should demand an apology, compensation, and guarantees against recurrence from Iran, regardless of whether it was intentional or accidental. (그러면서 전문가들은 이란에 의한 공격으로 확인될 경우, 의도적이든 우발적이든 정부는 이란에 사과와 배상, 재발 방지 등을 요구해야 한다고 했다.)

Professor Yoo suggested, “Once clear evidence is secured through a detailed investigation, South Korea should demand a clear apology and corresponding measures from Iran. On the working level, there is a need for behind-the-scenes negotiations to ensure the safe passage of South Korean ships detained in the Strait of Hormuz.” Former Ambassador Yoon said, “We need to obtain an expression of regret and a promise to prevent recurrence from Iran. Rather than focusing on freeing just a few of our stranded ships, it should be a higher priority to manage relations with Iran to ensure the long-term safe navigation of our vessels.” (유 교수는 “정밀 조사를 통해 분명한 증거를 확보하면 이란에 명확한 사과와 상응하는 조치를 요구해야 하고, 실무선에서는 호르무즈해협에 억류된 한국 선박들의 안전한 통과에 대한 물밑 협상을 진행할 필요가 있다”고 제안했다. 윤 전 대사는 “이란으로부터 유감 표명과 재발 방지 약속 등은 받아야 한다”며 “발이 묶여 있는 우리 배 몇척을 나오게 하는 것보다는 우리 선박의 안전한 항해가 장기적으로 보장되도록 하는 이란과의 관계 관리를 더 우선해야 한다”고 말했다.)

U.S. President Donald Trump insisted immediately after the incident that the Naju was attacked by Iran and demanded that South Korea contribute to opening the Strait of Hormuz. If the Naju is confirmed to have been hit by Iran, U.S. pressure is likely to intensify. The U.S. has already proposed that South Korea join the ‘Maritime Freedom Coalition’ (MFC), a multinational alliance for keeping the Strait of Hormuz open. (도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 사건 직후부터 나무호가 이란의 공격을 받았다면서 호르무즈해협 개방에 한국이 기여해야 한다고 요구했는데, 나무호가 실제로 이란으로부터 피격 당한 것으로 확인될 경우 미국의 요구도 강해질 가능성이 있다. 미국은 호르무즈해협 개방에 대한 다국적 연합체인 ‘해양자유연합’(MFC)에 한국의 참여를 제안한 상태다.)

Former Ambassador Yoon said, “After the war ends, if an initiative is formed involving all countries that use the Strait of Hormuz, we could participate. But joining a U.S.-led military operation just because the U.S. demands it now is not appropriate. The current situation is that even U.S. warships are afraid to enter the strait.” (윤 전 대사는 “전쟁이 끝난 뒤에 호르무즈해협을 이용하는 모든 국가가 참여하는 이니셔티브가 구성되면 우리가 참여할 수 있지만, 지금 미국이 요구한다고 미국이 주도하는 군사 작전에 참여하는 것은 적절하지 않다”며 “현재는 미국 군함도 두려워서 해협에 진입하지 못하는 상황”이라고 말했다.)

Senior Correspondent Park Min-hee minggu@hani.co.kr (박민희 선임기자 minggu@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "The Democratic Party's Preferential Voting System for National Assembly Speaker Saves Costs and Time" (이 대통령 “민주당 국회의장 후보 선호투표제, 비용·시간 아끼는 것”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung stated regarding the preferential voting system implemented in the Democratic Party of Korea's primary for the National Assembly speaker candidate, "It is meant to save the costs and time required for a runoff election," adding, "If South Korea introduces a runoff system for elections such as the presidential election, we will discuss simultaneously adopting a preferential voting system." (이재명 대통령이 더불어민주당 국회의장 후보 경선에서 시행되는 선호투표제에 대해 “결선투표를 위한 비용과 시간을 아끼기 위한 것”이라며 “우리나라도 대선 등의 선거에서 결선투표제를 도입할 경우 선호투표제 동시도입을 논의하게 될 것”이라고 말했다.)

In a post on X on the 11th, President Lee said, "The preferential voting system was introduced alongside the runoff system when I was the leader of the Democratic Party." The Democratic Party has been conducting a two-day vote among eligible party members starting that day to select the candidate for the speaker of the second half of the National Assembly. In response to a post from an X user who had completed voting, asking, "If only one person is to be elected, why rank them?" Lee explained the purpose of the preferential voting system in a reply format. The candidates in this primary are lawmakers Park Ji-won, Cho Jung-sik, and Kim Tae-nyeon (in the order of their assigned symbols). (이 대통령은 11일 엑스(X)에 올린 글에서 “선호투표제는 제가 민주당 대표일 때 결선투표제와 함께 도입한 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 민주당은 이날부터 이틀간 국회 후반기 의장 후보를 뽑는 권리당원 투표를 실시 중인데, 투표를 완료했다는 한 엑스 이용자가 “뽑을 사람은 한명인데 왜 순위를 매기느냐”는 글을 올리자 답글 형식으로 선호투표제 취지를 설명했다. 이번 경선에는 박지원·조정식·김태년(기호순) 의원이 출마했다. )

The preferential voting system is implemented when there are three or more candidates in the Democratic Party's process for selecting the National Assembly speaker candidate and floor leader. If no candidate receives a majority in the first round of voting, the core idea is to add the second-preference votes of voters who chose the third-place candidate as their first preference to the vote counts of the first- and second-place candidates to determine a majority winner. Accordingly, participants in the vote must indicate their preference rankings for all candidates. The X user stated that they voted for Cho Jung-sik as their first choice among the National Assembly speaker primary candidates. (선호투표제는 민주당 국회의장 후보 및 원내대표 선출 과정에서 경선 후보자가 3인 이상일 때 실시한다. 1차 투표에서 과반 득표자가 나오지 않으면, 3위 후보자를 1순위로 택한 유권자의 2순위 표를 1, 2위 후보자의 득표수에 더해 과반 득표자를 가리는 것이 골자다. 이에 따라 투표 참여자들은 모든 후보자에 대한 선호 순위를 표기해야 한다. 이 엑스 이용자는 국회의장 경선 후보 가운데 조정식 의원에게 1위 투표를 했다고 밝혔다)

President Lee explained, "This is a method of effectively conducting a runoff vote in advance within the first round of voting," adding, "It has the limitation that voters who selected the first- and second-place candidates in the first round are considered to have made the same choices in the runoff." He continued, "Please be aware that if you do not select a second choice, you would effectively be abstaining from the runoff vote if your first-choice candidate is eliminated. Please avoid misunderstanding and be sure to select both your first and second preferences." (이 대통령은 “1차 투표에서 예비적으로 결선투표를 미리 해 두는 방안”이라며 “1차 투표에서 1, 2위를 선택한 선거권자는 결선투표에서도 동일한 선택을 하는 것으로 간주하는 한계가 있다”고 설명했다. 이어 “2등을 선택해 두지 않으면 본인이 1등으로 선택한 후보가 탈락한 결선투표에는 기권하는 결과가 되는 점을 숙지하시고, 오해하지 마시고 1, 2등 선호를 모두 선택하시기 바란다”고 했다.)

Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (심우삼 기자 wu32@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk expands his reach in Yeongnam… In the capital region, calls for "stepping back to the second line" (영남서 보폭 넓히는 장동혁…수도권선 “2선 후퇴” 요구)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, is broadening his scope of activities, focusing on the Yeongnam region including Daegu, Busan, and Ulsan, about 20 days ahead of the June 3 local elections. After being subjected to "public criticism" during on-site meetings following his 8-night, 10-day visit to the U.S. last month, he paused his regional activities, but has recently been widening his stride, centering on battleground areas. <<> On the afternoon of the 11th, Leader Jang attended the "Ulsan City Party Election Committee Inauguration Ceremony" held at the People Power Party's Ulsan City Party office, accompanied by the party leadership. Introducing Ulsan mayoral candidate Kim Doo-gyeom, Jang stated, "You have truly engaged in politics for a long time, and your abilities as a mayor have been recognized. You are a strong candidate who can protect Ulsan." He added, "To resume the trial of President Lee Jae-myung and ensure he can be sent to prison, you must secure a victory in Ulsan." Leader Jang attended the opening ceremony of Park Min-sik's campaign office for the Busan Buk-gu Gap parliamentary by-election on the 8th, and the following day, the 9th, he attended the opening ceremony of Kim Tae-heum's campaign office for the South Chungcheong Province governor election. <<> The People Power Party plans to soon announce the formation of a central election committee centered around Leader Jang. Senior Spokesperson Park Seong-hoon told reporters that day, "We will announce the central election committee before candidate registration this Thursday or Friday," adding, "Since the party leader has previously served as the chairperson of the standing election committee, this time will be no different." <<> Amid this, Joo Gwang-deok, a preliminary candidate for the Namyangju mayoral election under the People Power Party, stated that if Leader Jang does not step back to the second line, he will not register as a candidate. In a press conference at the National Assembly, Preliminary Candidate Joo said, "Leader (Jang Dong-hyuk), please step back to the second line. This is my final loyalty, as I cannot bear to watch the party collapse with open eyes," and added, "If this demand is not accepted, I will not register as a candidate." <<> Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 6·3 지방선거를 20여일 앞두고 대구·부산·울산 등 영남 지역을 중심으로 활동 반경을 넓히고 있다. 지난달 8박10일 방미 뒤 현장 회의에서 ‘공개 비난’을 듣고 지역 행보를 멈췄지만, 최근 격전지 등을 중심으로 보폭을 넓히고 있다.)

item.title: DP on Edge Over Jeonbuk Poll?… Relentless 'Check' on Independent Kim Gwan-young (민주, 전북 여론조사에 긴장?…무소속 김관영에 연일 ‘견제구’)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea (DP) is steadily raising the pressure on incumbent Governor Kim Gwan-young, who has declared his independent candidacy for the Jeonbuk Special Self-Governing Province gubernatorial election on June 3. Kim, expelled from the party over allegations of distributing cash for designated driver fees, is showing competitiveness against DP candidate Lee Won-taek in opinion polls, fueling a tense atmosphere. (더불어민주당이 6·3 지방선거 전북특별자치도지사 선거에 무소속 출마를 선언한 김관영 현 지사에 대한 견제 수위를 연일 끌어올리고 있다. 대리운전비 현금 살포 의혹으로 당에서 제명된 김 후보가 이원택 민주당 후보를 상대로 여론조사에서 경쟁력을 보이면서 긴장하는 분위기다.)

DP Chief Jeong Cheong-rae said on the 11th at a Seoul-area candidate convention held at the Korea Federation of Small and Medium Businesses in Yeouido, “Do you have the confidence to win as an independent? Please remember you are in the arms of the DP members.” Although this remark was made at a gathering of Seoul-area candidates for the June 3 local elections, including Seoul mayoral candidate Jeong Won-oh, it was interpreted as targeting Kim. <<>= Floor Leader Han Byeong-do, whose constituency is Iksan-eul in Jeonbuk, added an extra schedule on the same day to hold a press briefing at the Jeonbuk Provincial Council, stating, “Jeonbuk’s development can only happen if a candidate from the ruling DP wins.” The previous day, Secretary-General Jo Seung-rae warned Kim that running as an independent constitutes a 'grave breach of party discipline' and that he would forever be barred from rejoining the party. (정청래 민주당 대표는 11일 서울 여의도 중소기업중앙회에서 열린 서울지역 공천자 대회에서 “무소속으로 당선될 자신이 있나. 여러분은 민주당 당원들 품 속에 있다는 사실을 명심해달라”고 말했다. 정원오 서울시장 후보 등 6·3 지방선거 서울지역 후보자들이 참석한 자리에서 한 발언이었지만, 김 후보를 겨냥한 발언이란 해석이 나왔다.)

The DP's sustained offensive is likely due to assessments that Kim retains considerable local support despite his independent run. In a survey of 1,000 Jeonbuk residents conducted by Research firm Jo Won C&I on the 9th and 10th, commissioned by News1 (using mobile phone virtual numbers in an automated response method), Kim garnered 43.2% support, while Lee received 39.7%. (For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website.) Kim’s camp believes that public sentiment in the region views as unfair the central party's actions, such as the investigation into Kim's alleged cash disbursement for designated driver fees and the probe into Lee's alleged third-party payment of meal costs. (전북 익산을이 지역구인 한병도 원내대표는 이날 일정을 추가해 전북도의회에서 기자간담회를 열고 “전북 발전은 집권 여당인 민주당 후보가 당선돼야 가능한 일”이라고 말했다. 전날 조승래 사무총장은 김 후보를 향해 무소속 출마는 ‘중대한 해당 행위’라며 영원히 복당이 불가능할 것이란 경고를 내놓기도 했다.)

Choi Ha-yan Reporter chy@hani.co.kr Cheon Gyeong-seok Reporter 1000press@hani.co.kr (연일 이어지는 민주당의 공세는 김 후보가 무소속 출마를 선언했음에도 지역 지지세가 만만치 않다는 평가가 나오기 때문인 것으로 보인다. 여론조사 전문기관 조원씨앤아이가 9~10일 뉴스1 의뢰로 전북 거주 1천명을 대상으로 한 전북지사 적합도 조사(휴대전화 가상번호 활용 자동응답 방식)에서 김 후보는 43.2%, 이 후보는 39.7%를 기록했다.(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조) 김 후보 쪽은 대리운전비 현금 살포 의혹과 이 후보의 식사비 제3자 대납 의혹에 대한 중앙당의 감찰 등 조처가 불공정했다는 여론이 지역 내에서 형성되고 있다고 보고 있다.)

item.title: DP’s ‘Balanced Development’ vs. PPP’s ‘Housing Stability’ as Top Pledges… A Look at Each Party’s Top 10 Campaign Promises (민주 ‘균형발전’-국힘 ‘주거안정’ 1호 공약…정당별 10대 공약 보니)
item.description:
On May 11, 23 days before the June 3 local elections, rival parties unveiled their top 10 campaign pledges. The Democratic Party (DP), which is focusing on winning over voters in the Yeongnam region, highlighted ‘regional balanced development,’ while the People Power Party (PPP), aiming to tap into public sentiment on real estate, promoted ‘housing stability’ as its key pledge. (6·3 지방선거를 23일 앞둔 11일 여야 정당들이 지방선거 10대 공약을 발표했다. 영남권 표심 확보에 공을 들이고 있는 더불어민주당은 ‘지역균형발전’을, 부동산 민심을 파고들려는 국민의힘은 ‘주거 안정’을 주요 공약으로 내세웠다.)

According to the policies and pledges of 15 political parties published on the website of the National Election Commission on the same day, the DP designated ‘building an administrative, fiscal, and institutional foundation for balanced development’ as its top priority. The plan is to complete the ‘5 Poles, 3 Specialties’ (five mega-regions and three special self-governing provinces) strategy for national balanced development under the Lee Jae-myung administration, partly through the integration of metropolitan governments beyond South Jeolla and Gwangju. The DP also unveiled plans to foster key regional industries by designating ‘mega special zones’ with eased regulations and support in finance, taxation, and workforce, as well as to nurture new AI (artificial intelligence) industries and build a growth foundation. (중앙선거관리위원회가 이날 누리집에 공개한 15개 정당의 정책·공약을 보면, 민주당은 ‘균형발전을 위한 행정·재정·제도 기반 구축’을 첫번째 과제로 꼽았다. 전남·광주 이외에 광역 지방정부의 통합 등을 통해 이재명 정부의 국가 균형발전 전략인 ‘5극 3특’(5개 초광역권과 3개 특별자치도)을 완성하겠다는 구상이다. 민주당은 규제를 완화하고, 재정·세제·인력을 지원하는 ‘메가특구’를 지정해 지역 핵심 산업을 육성하고, 에이아이(AI·인공지능) 신산업 육성 및 성장기반을 구축하겠다는 계획도 내놨다.)

Additionally, the DP presented key pledges including: △ close support for youth, national asset formation, and reduction of household living expenses; △ national livelihood stability, care support, and response to low birth rates and an aging population; △ response to the RE100 climate crisis; △ support for startups, small business owners, and SMEs; and △ strengthening public safety, including for women. (이밖에 민주당은 △청년밀착 지원 국민 자산 형성 및 가계생활비 경감 지원 △국민 생활안정, 돌봄 지원, 저출생고령화 대응 △알이(RE)100 기후위기 대응 △창업·소상공인·중소기업 지원 △여성 등 국민안전 강화 등도 핵심 공약으로 제시했다.)

The PPP put forward ‘housing stability,’ centered on introducing ‘half-price jeonse’ (long-term rental deposits), as its top pledge. Key promises include promoting ‘half-price jeonse’ by supplying long-term rental housing at 50% of surrounding prices, expanding the tax credit for monthly rent, abolishing the recapture of excess profits from reconstruction, and reinstating benefits for long-term rental business operators. This is interpreted as a strategy to differentiate itself from the government and ruling party’s real estate policies while aggressively targeting public sentiment on property. The second pledge was ‘a great economic leap through regulatory abolition and new industry growth,’ which includes introducing a Korean version of the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) tax incentive for domestic production and fully implementing a negative regulatory system. For youth pledges, the party proposed 1,000-won housing, 1,000-won breakfast, improved monthly rent support for young people, and mandatory quotas for public rental housing for youth and newlyweds. (국민의힘은 ‘반값 전세’ 도입을 골자로 한 ‘주거 안정’을 1호 공약으로 내세웠다. 주변 가격의 50%로 장기전세주택을 공급하는 ‘반값 전세’ 추진, 월세 세액공제 확대, 재건축 초과이익 환수제 폐지, 장기임대사업자 혜택 부활 등이 핵심 공약이다. 정부·여당의 부동산 정책과 차별화하며 부동산 민심을 집중적으로 파고들겠다는 전략으로 풀이된다. 한국판 국내생산촉진세제(IRA) 도입, 네거티브 방식의 규제 시스템 전면 도입 등의 내용이 담긴 ‘규제 철폐와 신산업 성장을 통한 경제 대도약’은 두번째 공약으로 제시했다. 청년 공약으로는 천원주택, 천원의 아침밥, 청년 월세 지원 향상, 청년·신혼부부 공공임대 쿼터제 의무화 등을 내세웠다.)

The Rebuilding Korea Party (RKP) put forward a ’99-year lifetime secure home’ as its top pledge. It promises to guarantee housing rights by supplying high-quality public rental apartment complexes nationwide that are permanently owned by the public without conversion to sale. The Progressive Party prioritized the ’nationalization of local public services, building local public assets, and realizing a local circular economy’ through measures such as bus nationalization and establishing regional public banks. The Reform Party promoted a ’growth economy that reduces regulations and fosters innovation.’ Key measures include a ’zero-burden package for youth startups’ for entrepreneurs aged 39 and under, encompassing temporary support for workplace rent, reduced corporate establishment costs, and tax and legal advisory services. (조국혁신당은 ‘99년 평생 안심 내 집’을 1호 공약으로 내세웠다. 분양전환 없이 공공이 영구 보유하는 고품질의 공공임대 아파트 단지를 전국에 공급해 주거권을 보장한다는 공약이다. 진보당은 버스 공영화, 지역공공은행 설립 등을 통한 ‘지역공공서비스 공영화와 지역공공자산 구축, 지역순환경제 실현’을 첫번째 공약으로 내세웠다. 개혁신당은 ‘규제는 줄이고, 혁신은 키우는 성장경제’를 내세웠다. 만 39살 이하 청년 창업자 대상 사업장 임대료 한시 지원, 법인 설립 비용 감면, 세무·법률 자문 등을 포함한 ‘청년 창업 제로 부담 패키지’ 추진 등이 주요 내용이다.)

The Basic Income Party advocated for ’realizing local government-level basic income’ by implementing basic income (300,000 won per month) for rural areas and children, adolescents, and youth. The Social Democratic Party put forward ’responding to AI inequality and job insecurity’ as its top pledge, while the Justice Party called for ‘building a system where the public takes responsibility for basic services such as housing, food, transportation, and medical care’ as its number one pledge. (기본소득당은 농어촌 및 아동·청소년·청년 기본소득(월 30만원)을 시행하는 ‘지방정부형 기본소득 실현’을, 사회민주당은 ‘에이아이 불평등 및 고용 불안 대응’을, 정의당은 ‘주거, 먹거리, 교통, 의료 등 기본서비스를 공공이 책임지는 체제 구축’을 제1공약으로 내세웠다.)

item.title: Kang Hoon-sik on High School Student's Murder: "Extraordinary Measures Needed... We Must Painfully Listen to Youths' Questions" (강훈식, 고교생 피살에 “특단 대책…청소년들 물음 아프게 들어야”)
item.description:
Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, regarding the murder of a high school student in Gwangju, stated, "This incident must not be taken lightly," and instructed the government to prepare extraordinary measures. <<> Deputy Spokesperson Ahn Gwi-ryung of the presidential office reported that Chief Kang made these remarks during a meeting of senior presidential secretaries he chaired, noting that students in the affected area have been issuing statements calling for strict punishment of the perpetrator. Since the incident on the 5th, where a 17-year-old female high school student returning home in Gwangju was fatally stabbed by a 20-something male stranger, high school students in Gwangju and Gangwon Province have been issuing successive statements urging social attention to the case, strong punishment for the perpetrator, and measures to prevent recurrence. <<> In a Facebook post on the same day, Chief Kang said, "A youth was harmed by an adult's violence. The victims are asking whether safety issues for youths and other vulnerable groups in our society are being neglected. We must listen painstakingly." <<> During the meeting, he expressed condolences and solidarity to the bereaved family and local students, and instructed Senior Secretary for Communication Jeon Seong-hwan to "meet directly with the bereaved family and the family of the injured student, convey the government's condolences, and carefully ensure that necessary support and measures are promptly implemented." Secretary Jeon immediately moved to the scene. Chief Kang also requested the National Police Agency to "conduct thorough investigations, strengthen patrols during crime-vulnerable times and locations, and carry out day-and-night safety inspections of student commuting routes and reinforce security facilities to implement extraordinary safety measures so that youths are not exposed to random crimes." <<> Reporter Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr (강훈식 대통령비서실장이 광주 고교생 피살 사건과 관련해 “이번 사건을 결코 가볍게 여겨서는 안 된다”라며 정부에 특단의 대책을 마련하라고 지시했다.)

item.title: National Security Office Chief: "Strongly Condemns Attack on M.V. HMM MUH"… Debris Identified as Drone Remains (위성락 “나무호 공격 강력히 규탄”…잔해는 드론으로 확인)
item.description:
National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac stated on the 11th regarding the attack on the HMM MUH while it was anchored in the Strait of Hormuz: "Our government's position is that attacks on civilian vessels such as the HMM MUH cannot be justified or tolerated, and we strongly condemn this act." The government has secured drone engine debris from the hull of the HMM MUH and has initiated further investigations. (위성락 국가안보실장이 11일 호르무즈해협에서 정박 중이던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호 피격에 대해 “우리 정부는 나무호 등 민간 선박에 대한 공격은 정당화되거나 용납될 수 없다는 입장으로, 이를 강력히 규탄한다”고 말했다. 정부는 나무호 선체에서 드론 엔진 잔해를 확보하고 추가 조사에 들어갔다.)

During a briefing at the presidential office (Cheong Wa Dae) that day, Director Wi said: "Military attacks on ordinary commercial vessels are clearly unacceptable and subject to criticism. We will take appropriate measures at the appropriate level once our assessment is complete." (위 실장은 이날 청와대에서 한 브리핑에서 “일반 상선에 대한 군사적 공격은 용납될 수 없고 비판의 대상임이 분명하다”며 “판단이 서는 대로 적절한 수위의 대처를 할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Regarding the attack situation, Director Wi stated: "Two unidentified aircraft struck the stern plating of the HMM MUH twice, approximately one minute apart, resulting in flames and smoke accompanied by vibrations. Considering that the ship was damaged at a point 1 to 1.5 meters above the waterline at the time of the incident, as well as the damage patterns, the possibility of an attack by mines or torpedoes appears low." (위 실장은 피격 상황에 관해 “미상의 비행체 2기가 나무호 선미 외판을 약 1분 간격으로 두차례 타격했고, 진동을 동반한 화염과 연기가 발생했다”며 “사고 당시 해수면보다 1~1.5m 상단 부분에 선박 파손이 있었다는 점이나 파손 패턴 등을 고려하면 기뢰나 어뢰에 의한 피격 가능성은 작은 것으로 보인다”고 말했다.)

However, Cheong Wa Dae did not identify the entity responsible for the attack. A senior official from Cheong Wa Dae stated: "We are not currently identifying the attacker; we are working to determine the cause. Until then, it is difficult to say that we will take measures based on prejudice or premature conclusions about the attacker." Regarding future responses, this official added: "Our response will likely not differ significantly from how other countries handle similar situations." Notably, France and China, which experienced attacks on their vessels around the same time as the HMM MUH, have also mentioned the attacks without specifying the attackers. (다만 청와대는 공격 주체가 어디인지는 언급하지 않았다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “지금 공격 주체를 특정하지 않고, (원인을 밝히는 데) 노력하고 있다”며 “그때까지 (공격 주체에) 예단을 갖거나 미리 단정해 조치하겠다고 말하긴 어렵다”고 했다. 이 관계자는 향후 대응에 관해 “대처는 상식적으로 다른 나라들이 이런 유사한 상황에 대처하는 것과 크게 다르지 않을 것”이라고 말했다. 앞서 나무호와 비슷한 시기에 선박 공격을 받은 프랑스와 중국 역시 피격 사실은 언급하면서도 공격 주체를 명시하지 않았다.)

Amidst this, the government has confirmed the recovery of drone engine debris from the hull of the HMM MUH. Multiple sources from the ruling party told *The Hankyoreh*: "Drone debris has been secured from the HMM MUH's hull and will be brought to South Korea soon for analysis." The Ministry of Foreign Affairs had previously stated the previous day, "Further investigation is needed to determine whether the projectile was a drone or a missile," without clarifying further. A senior Cheong Wa Dae official, when asked about the debris of the aircraft that day, only stated: "We will speak when additional information is gathered and an assessment is made." (이런 가운데 정부는 나무호 선체에서 드론 엔진 잔해를 확보한 것으로 확인됐다. 복수의 여권 소식통은 한겨레에 “나무호 선체에서 드론 잔해를 확보했고, 곧 한국으로 가져와 감식할 예정”이라고 말했다. 외교부는 전날 “발사체가 드론인지 미사일인지 추가 조사가 필요하다”며 명확히 밝히지 않았다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 이날 비행체 잔해와 관련한 질문에 “추가적인 정보가 파악되고 판단이 서게 되면 말하겠다”고만 말했다.)

Seo Young-ji and Shim Woo-sam, reporters, yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 심우삼 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: People Power Party Claims “Iran Admits to Attacking the HMM Nammoo” … Democratic Party Says “Unfounded Attacks Harm National Interest” (국힘 “나무호 피격, 이란 자백”…민주 “근거 없는 공격, 국익 해쳐”)
item.description:
Amid findings that the explosion and fire on the HMM Nammoo, which was anchored in the Strait of Hormuz, were caused by a strike from an unidentified flying object, the conservative opposition party has pushed back, demanding that the government reveal the perpetrator. The Democratic Party of Korea characterized this as a “political offensive aimed at the elections,” retorting that “they are stoking partisan strife even before the exact investigation results are out.” <<> Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, said at a Supreme Council meeting held at the National Assembly on the 11th: “The first results of the government investigation team are missing two essential characters: ‘Iran.’ Iran’s state broadcaster has already reported that they targeted a Korean vessel. The attacker is confessing, but the victim is denying it.” Regarding the government’s statement that the attacker was an unidentified flying object, he asked, “Did an alien UFO attack occur?” and claimed, “The money that the Lee Jae-myung regime gave to Iran may have returned as a drone that attacked our ship.” Floor leader Choo Kyung-ho stated, “It looks like a sluggish, downplaying response for a serious security issue involving the lives and safety of the people. The government must transparently disclose to the public the details and response process of the HMM Nammoo attack.” <<> Lawmakers from the People Power Party on the National Defense Committee and Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee held a joint press conference at the National Assembly on the same day, accusing the government of covering up facts related to the attack and urging the convening of a full committee meeting for urgent inquiries. The National Defense Committee held a full meeting in the afternoon led by the People Power Party, but the government and ruling party did not attend due to a breakdown in negotiations between the ruling and opposition party secretaries. The Reform Party sent a letter to the Iranian Ambassador to South Korea, Saeed Koozechi, on the same day, stating, “Protecting our citizens and our ships is not a matter of choice. If attacks on Korean ships continue, the Reform Party will urge the Korean government to take stronger diplomatic and legal action.” <<> In contrast, the Democratic Party of Korea has adopted a cautious approach, aligning with the government. Deputy spokesperson Boo Seung-chan of the Democratic Party’s Central Election Strategy Committee issued a commentary, noting, “The facts—who the attacker is, whether it was an intentional strike or an accident—have a massive impact on diplomatic responses afterward. The People Power Party completely ignores this complex reality and the basics of diplomacy. They repeat irresponsible and ruinous behavior, using security as a tool for partisan strife solely to attack the Lee Jae-myung administration.” Rep. Kim Young-bae, the Democratic Party’s secretary on the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee, also addressed the People Power Party’s demand for a committee meeting, emphasizing, “The Democratic Party believes it’s better to hold a committee meeting once the type of aircraft and the attacker are identified,” and stressed they were not avoiding it. <<> A Democratic Party lawmaker on the Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee told The Hankyoreh on the same day, “I don’t know what they want to do when the type of aircraft and the attacker haven’t even been identified. Isn’t this just using the issue for election purposes and potentially threatening the safety of our overseas nationals?” Another Democratic Party lawmaker said, “Unfounded malicious propaganda or attacks are also inappropriate from a national interest perspective.” <<> Jang Narae Reporter wing@hani.co.kr Ko Kyungju Reporter goh@hani.co.kr
Yoo Youngjae Reporter young@hani.co.kr (호르무즈해협에 정박해 있던 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호의 폭발·화재 원인이 외부 비행체의 타격으로 지목된 가운데 보수 야당이 정부에 공격 주체를 밝히라고 요구하며 반발했다. 더불어민주당은 ‘선거를 겨냥한 정치 공세’로 규정하고 “정확한 조사 결과가 나오기도 전에 정쟁의 군불부터 때고 있다”고 맞받았다.)

item.title: Korea Football Association Submits Application to Allow North Korean 'Naegohyang Women's Football Team' to Visit the South (축구협회 ‘북한 내고향여자축구단’ 방남 허가신청서 제출)
item.description:
The Korea Football Association has submitted an application for permission to allow the North Korean women's football team 'Naegohyang Women's Football Team' to visit South Korea. (대한축구협회가 북한 여자 축구단 ‘내고향여자축구단’의 남한 방문을 위한 방남 허가 신청서를 제출했다.)

The Ministry of Unification announced on the 11th that the Korea Football Association submitted the application for Naegohyang Women's Football Team (Naegohyang) to visit the South online to the ministry the previous day (the 10th). Under the law on inter-Korean exchange and cooperation, any North Korean resident wishing to visit South Korea must possess a visitor certificate issued by the Minister of Unification. The Korea Football Association applied for the visit permit after receiving the list of the North Korean athletes and support staff scheduled to visit through the Asian Football Confederation (AFC). (통일부는 축구협회가 전날(10일) 통일부에 내고향여자축구단(내고향)의 방남 허가 신청을 온라인으로 제출했다고 11일 밝혔다. 남북교류협력에 관한 법률상 북한의 주민이 남한을 방문하려면 통일부 장관이 발급한 방문증명서를 소지해야 한다. 축구협회는 아시아축구연맹(AFC)을 통해 방남 예정인 북한 선수단과 지원 인력의 명단을 받아 방남 허가를 신청했다.)

According to the list received by the Asian Football Confederation from North Korea, the visiting group consists of 39 people, including 27 Naegohyang players and 12 staff members. They are scheduled to enter South Korea via Incheon Airport through Beijing, China, on the 17th. The Ministry of Unification plans to approve the visit by the 17th, the scheduled arrival date of Naegohyang, following consultations with relevant agencies. A ministry official stated, "The list of 39 people includes four reserve players, so it is not yet certain whether all of them will visit," indicating that the number of visitors might be fewer than 39. (아시아축구연맹이 북한으로부터 받은 명단상 방남 인원은 내고향 선수 27명, 스태프 12명 등 39명으로, 오는 17일 중국 베이징을 거쳐 인천공항을 통해 남한에 들어온다. 통일부는 관계기관 협의를 거쳐 내고향의 도착 예정일인 17일 전까지 방문 승인을 할 계획이다. 통일부 관계자는 “39명 명단에 예비 선수 인력도 4명 포함돼 있어 이들이 모두 방문할지는 아직 불확실하다”고 해, 39명보다 적은 인원이 방문할 가능성도 있다고 밝혔다.)

The Korea Football Association's application for the visit was made independently based on the list received from the Asian Football Confederation, in accordance with South Korean procedures, without separate communication with the North Korean side. As a result, there are observations that North Korea might refuse entry following the visit application and demand immigration procedures through passport verification. Amid the situation where North Korea defines inter-Korean relations as a 'two-state' relationship, it could express its intention to undergo identity and entry requirement checks through passport screening, similar to general state-to-state relations. Immigration screening also requires consultation with the Ministry of Justice. Indeed, the Ministry of Unification is reportedly reviewing relevant response measures considering this point. (축구협회의 방남 신청은 북한 쪽과 따로 소통을 거치진 않고, 우리 절차에 따라 아시아축구연맹에서 받은 명단을 토대로 자체 신청한 것이다. 이에 북한 쪽에서 방남 신청에 따른 입국을 거부하고 여권 확인을 통한 출입국 절차를 요구할 가능성도 있다는 관측이 나온다. 북한이 남북을 ‘두 국가’ 관계로 규정하는 상황에서 일반적인 국가 대 국가 관계와 같이 여권 심사를 거쳐 신원 등 입국 요건을 확인받겠다는 뜻을 밝힐 수 있다는 것이다. 출입국 심사는 법무부와도 협의가 필요하다. 실제로 통일부는 이런 점을 고려해 관련 대응 방안을 검토 중인 것으로 전해졌다.)

After arriving in Incheon on the 17th, Naegohyang will play a semifinal match of the Asian Football Confederation Women's Champions League against Suwon FC Women at Suwon Sports Complex on the 20th. The winner will compete for the championship against the winner of the semifinal match between Melbourne City and Tokyo Verdy at 2 p.m. on the 23rd at the same venue. (내고향은 17일 인천에 도착한 뒤, 20일 수원FC 위민과 수원종합운동장에서 아시아축구연맹 여자 챔피언스리그 4강전을 한다. 승자는 멜버른 시티-도쿄 베르디의 4강전 승자와 오는 23일 오후 2시 같은 곳에서 우승을 다툰다.)

item.title: ‘Attacked’ – France and China Also Do Not Specify… Blue House Cautious Over Diplomatic Fallout (‘피격’ 프랑스·중국도 명시 안 해…청와대, 외교 파장 ‘신중’)
item.description:
The Blue House on the 11th “strongly condemned” the attack on the HMM *Namuho*, but did not specify the perpetrator. This is because hastily pointing fingers at Iran could jeopardize the safety of about 20 South Korean vessels stranded in the Strait of Hormuz and potentially lead to pressure from the U.S. to join its anti-Iran coalition. The government is expected to maintain a cautious stance until further investigation results emerge. (청와대가 11일 에이치엠엠(HMM) 나무호 피격 사건에 대해 “강력히 규탄한다”면서도 공격 주체를 명시하지 않았다. 이란을 섣불리 지목할 경우 호르무즈해협에 묶인 20여척의 한국 선박에 대한 안전을 확보하기 어려운데다, 미국의 대이란 공조 압박으로 이어질 수 있기 때문이다. 정부는 추가 조사 결과가 나올 때까지 최대한 신중한 태도를 유지할 것으로 보인다.)

A senior Blue House official told reporters on the same day, “Whether the external attack on the *Namuho* is related to Iran is currently an unknown territory.” He added, “No specific country has been identified. We are looking into possibilities involving multiple countries.” While sources inside and outside the government suggest a high likelihood of Iranian involvement, this has not been acknowledged. Regarding the Foreign Ministry summoning Iranian Ambassador to South Korea Saeed Kouzehchi the previous day, the official explained, “It wasn’t about singling out a specific target, but rather about communication and consultation with one of the neighboring countries,” denying that it was a formal protest. (청와대 고위 관계자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “(나무호의 외부 공격이) 이란과 관련이 있는지는 지금 현재는 미지의 영역”이라며 “어느 나라가 특정돼 있지는 않다. 여러 나라의 가능성을 놓고 파악하고 있다”고 말했다. 정부 안팎에서는 이란의 공격 가능성이 높다고 보고 있지만, 이를 인정하지는 않은 것이다. 이 관계자는 전날 외교부가 사이드 쿠제치 주한 이란대사를 부른 것에 관해서도 “대상을 특정한 것이 아니라 인근 나라 가운데 하나이기 때문에 소통, 협의하는 차원이었다”며 ‘초치’라는 해석을 부인했다.)

The government’s cautious stance stems from the significant diplomatic repercussions that could follow a definitive judgment. If Iran’s attack is confirmed, the deterioration of relations with Iran, cultivated with effort so far, would be unavoidable. Currently, besides the *Namuho*, 25 South Korean vessels remain in the Strait of Hormuz. Strained ties with Iran could disrupt the passage of South Korean ships through the strait and the securing of crude oil. (정부가 신중한 태도를 유지하는 것은 판단 이후의 외교적 파장이 만만찮기 때문이다. 이란의 공격이 사실로 확인될 경우 그동안 공들여온 이란과의 관계 악화가 일정 부분 불가피하다. 현재 호르무즈해협에는 나무호 외에도 우리 선박 25척이 남아 있다. 이란과의 관계가 악화하면 전후 한국 선박의 호르무즈해협 통과와 원유 확보에도 차질이 생길 수 있다.)

Pressure from the U.S. for military cooperation is also seen as a factor behind the caution. If South Korea concludes that Iran carried out the attack, the U.S. is likely to ramp up pressure for participation in the ‘Liberation Project’ (Project Freedom), which has been on hold. A senior Blue House official stated, “I don’t think it’s to the point of directly linking (participation in the U.S.-proposed Maritime Freedom Coalition (MFC) and this attack).” He added, “It is true that we were attacked and that’s something to condemn, but the perpetrator hasn’t been identified yet,” reiterating a basic stance. (미국의 군사적 협력 압박도 신중론의 배경으로 풀이된다. 한국이 이란의 공격을 받았다고 결론을 내릴 경우 미국은 중단 상태인 ‘해방 프로젝트’(프로젝트 프리덤) 참여를 다시 압박할 가능성이 적지 않다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “(미국이 제안한 해양자유연합(MFC) 참여와 이번 공격을) 직접 연결시킬 정도는 아니라고 생각한다”며 “지금 우리가 피습당한 건 규탄할 일인 건 맞는데, 누가 했는지는 주체가 아직 특정되지 않은 단계다”라며 원론적 입장을 밝혔다.)

The government is expected to align its response level with countries like France, China, and Thailand, whose vessels were also attacked around the same time. France and China have confirmed the attacks but have not named a specific country like Iran as the perpetrator; Thailand lodged a protest with Iran through its foreign ministry. The senior Blue House official said, “We are closely watching how other countries are handling this. Our current response is not significantly different from how other countries are dealing with similar situations realistically.” (정부는 우리와 비슷한 시기 자국 선박이 공격받은 프랑스와 중국, 타이 등과 대응 수위를 맞출 것으로 보인다. 프랑스와 중국은 피격 사실은 확인했지만 ‘이란’ 등 특정 국가를 공격 주체로 명시하지 않았고, 타이는 외무부를 통해 이란에 항의했다. 청와대 고위 관계자는 “다른 나라들의 대처를 면밀히 보고 있다. 우리가 하고 있는 대처는 현실적으로 다른 나라들이 유사한 상황에 대처하는 것에서 크게 다르지 않다”고 말했다.)

Some interpret the “strong condemnation” message as an attempt to appease the domestic conservative base. With local elections on June 3 about 20 days away, the People Power Party and others are heavily criticizing the Lee Jae-myung government for being lukewarm toward Iran while failing to protect the people’s safety. In this context, the government may have issued the ‘condemnation’ message to show a firm stance. (일부에서는 “강력 규탄” 언급은 국내 보수층을 달래려는 메시지라는 풀이도 있다. 국민의힘 등은 6·3 지방선거를 20여일 앞두고 이재명 정부가 국민의 안전을 지키지 못한 채 이란에 미온적인 태도를 보이고 있다며 맹공을 펴고 있다. 이런 상황에서 정부가 ‘규탄’ 메시지를 내어 단호한 태도를 보이려 했다는 것이다.)

Meanwhile, regarding National Security Office Director Wi Sung-lac’s comment on the 6th that “we cannot be certain of the *Namuho* attack” and that “no report of a breach was received,” the Blue House stated, “It was not a misjudgment.” (한편, 청와대는 지난 6일 “나무호의 피격을 확신할 수 없다”고 한 위성락 국가안보실장의 언급에 대해서는 “파공이 있었다는 보고를 받지 못했다”며 “판단을 잘못 내린 것은 아니다”라고 말했다.)

By Seo Young-ji, Reporter yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Everyone shouts 'youth pledges,' but youth politics faces high barriers (너도나도 ‘청년 공약’ 외치지만…청년 정치 높은 벽)
item.description:
Ahead of the June 3 local elections, political parties and candidates are competing to put forward youth pledges, but in these elections as well, only a small number of those in their 20s and 30s, the actual stakeholders, are stepping forward as political actors to voice their opinions. The reasons cited include the fact that the barriers to entry remain high for young people, and political parties also take a passive stance toward nurturing young politicians. (6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 정당과 후보들이 앞다투어 청년 공약을 내놓고 있지만, 이번 선거에도 당사자인 20~30대들이 직접 정치적 주체로 나서 목소리를 내는 경우는 소수에 그치고 있다. 청년들에게 여전히 진입 장벽이 높은데다, 정당 역시 청년 정치인 양성에 소극적 태도를 보이는 것 등이 원인으로 꼽힌다.)

According to statistics from the National Election Commission on the 11th, the number of young preliminary candidates in their 20s and 30s registered for the local elections' super-regional chief executive races is 5, accounting for 7.4% of the total preliminary candidates (68). The number of young preliminary candidates who have thrown their hats into the ring for basic local government chief executive races is 17, which is about 1.9% of the total, and the number of young candidates running in super-regional council elections is 184, accounting for 9.2% of the total. Among candidates for basic local council elections, young candidates numbered 527, making up 10.2% of the total. Even after the final candidate registration concludes on the 15th, the proportion of young candidates is expected to be similar to that of the local elections four years ago, which were: △super-regional chief executive elections at 9.3%, △basic local government chief executive elections at 1.1%, △super-regional council elections at 8.0%, and △basic local council elections at 9.9%. <<> First, there are voices that the current election system, which requires giving up one's livelihood to enter the fray, acts as a barrier causing young people to hesitate to take on the challenge. For working youth, there is insufficient time to build name recognition while engaging in local activities, and the election costs that must be incurred from the primaries through the general election are also a burden. Ultimately, this creates a structure that is relatively advantageous for those who have money and time. A young politician active within the Democratic Party said, "There are livelihood issues in living the life of a full-time politician at a young age," and added, "There is a need to amend the Political Parties Act to allow the establishment of support groups for non-elected politicians (who can receive donations)." <<> Additionally, the closed and unpredictable nature of each political party's nomination process is another factor preventing young people from easily challenging politics. There are ongoing complaints from young politicians that it is not easy for newcomers to challenge nominations because local party chapter heads, who hold the power of nomination, sometimes support candidates they are connected to—such as those they will work closely with in the future based on personal ties, or individuals linked to their own supporters. Park Hyemin, CEO of the agency 'NewWays' that discovers young politicians, pointed out, "The problem is that the criteria for primaries and nominations are unclear and unpredictable, making it difficult for young people, who already have weak economic and social foundations, to bear the opportunity costs, such as quitting their jobs." <<> There are also persistent criticisms that, fundamentally, political parties lack systems for educating and nurturing young politicians, and that the single-member district system strengthens the two-party structure, serving as an obstacle to youth politics. <<> Lee Nae-young, a professor of political science and international relations at Korea University, stated, "If young people don't enter the National Assembly or local councils to represent the youth, there will be no one to create policies that reflect the concerns of young people," and added, "As in some European countries, it is necessary to set age and gender quotas to allow them to engage in political activities and thereby grow as politicians." <<> Reporter Jeong Hyemin jhm@hani.co.kr ( 11일 중앙선거관리위원회 통계를 보면, 지방선거 광역단체장 선거에 예비후보자로 등록한 20~30대 청년 후보자는 전체 예비후보자 수(68명)의 7.4%인 5명이다. 기초단체장 선거에 출사표를 던진 청년 예비후보자 수는 17명으로, 전체의 1.9% 수준이었고, 광역의원 선거에 출마하는 청년 후보자는 184명으로, 전체의 9.2%다. 기초의원 선거 후보자 중 청년 후보자는 527명으로, 전체의 10.2%였다. 오는 15일 최종 후보 등록이 마무리되더라도, 4년 전 지방선거 당시 청년 후보자 비율인 △광역단체장 선거 9.3% △기초단체장 선거 1.1% △광역의원 선거 8.0% △기초의원 선거 9.9% 수준이 될 것으로 보인다.)

item.title: “Even Among Family Members, Votes Are Different” “Even If Unified, Arithmetic Summation Won’t Be Possible” (“식구끼리도 표가 다릅니더” “단일화를 해도 산술적 합산 안될 것”)
item.description:
“Even among our own family, votes are different now.” (“우리 식구끼리도 지금 표가 다릅니더.”)

“Yesterday at the bathhouse, supporters were loudly arguing.” ( “어저께 목욕탕에서도 지지자들이 막 큰 소리로 싸웠어예.”)

In the lead-up to the June 3 by-election for the National Assembly, Buk-gu District A in Busan is emerging as the biggest battleground. Ha Jeong-woo of the Democratic Party of Korea, Park Min-sik of the People Power Party, and independent candidate Han Dong-hoon—none have established a clear solo lead, solidifying a three-way race. Predictions from citizens met in the Buk-gu District A area on the 10th–11th were also divided. In a SBS-Ipsos approval poll (telephone interview method) conducted from the 1st to the 3rd, Ha garnered 38%, Park 26%, and Han 21%; meanwhile, during the same period, a Busan MBC-Hangil Research poll (automated response method) showed Ha at 34.3%, Han at 33.5%, and Park at 21.5%, making it difficult to gauge the trend from opinion polls either. (Refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website for details.) <<> Support for Ha reflected the backing for former lawmaker Jeon Jae-soo, who had won three consecutive terms in Buk-gu District A. Hwang Jeong-ae (63), a resident of Buk-gu for 20 years, expressed optimism, saying, “Ha Jeong-woo will surely get support from the government. If Jeon Jae-soo becomes mayor, they can cooperate and push harder.” There were also opinions that Buk-gu District A, the only Democratic Party seat among Busan’s 18 districts, must be defended. Self-employed Yoon (39) said, “Is it right for the People Power Party to dominate even here?” Meanwhile, a 70-year-old life-long native Kim (surname withheld) showed a reserved attitude, saying, “Jeon Jae-soo gained a lot of favor, but I don’t know about Ha Jeong-woo. I’ve seen him greeting people, but I’ve never had a conversation with him.” <<> Voices regarding Park Min-sik revealed a sense of disappointment. Park (82), met at Gupo Market, said he would vote for Park but added, “He grew up in Buk-gu, Busan, and rose to success, but only shows his face around election time. When there were no poor people, the wealthy helped, but once money comes, it’s just like betrayal.” He referenced Park’s history: serving as a lawmaker for Buk-gu and Gangseo-gu District A (later reorganized) in the 18th and 19th National Assemblies, then declaring but abandoning a bid for a by-election in Seongnam Bundang-gu District A, Gyeonggi Province in 2022, and losing the 2024 22nd general election in Seoul Gangseo-gu District B. Kang (31), who runs a jewelry store, also said, “He’s from Buk-gu, but he’s like a migratory bird.” <<> Han Dong-hoon’s high profile, despite not being from Buk-gu, was confirmed on the ground. However, many reactions indicated that actual support differs. <<> Jeong (56), met in a residential area of Mandeok-dong, said, “Seeing Han Dong-hoon constantly on social media these days, I think he’ll win,” but Park (60), a merchant, dismissed this, saying, “Han Dong-hoon’s fans come from across the country, not from here (Buk-gu District A).” <<> Attention turned to a potential conservative unification, but many predicted its likelihood was low. Kang Hee-joong (60), who runs a noodle shop, asked, “I think unification is almost impossible. With fans backing him, would Han Dong-hoon yield?” Park (60), who identified as a People Power Party supporter, said, “If they don’t unify, Ha Jeong-woo will win. Park Min-sik should step aside. Why else would Jang Dong-hyuk push out Han Dong-hoon? Because it was disadvantageous for him.” In contrast, Kim (70), a merchant, declared, “Han Dong-hoon betrayed us. If they rally behind Han, I won’t vote at all. Even if I dislike him, once more—it’s Park Min-sik.” Park Se-hyeon (47) said, “Han Dong-hoon supporters are more like a personal fan base, so even if they unify, there will be defectors.” <<> Busan/Jo Hui-yeon, Reporter choh@hani.co.kr ( 6·3 국회의원 재보궐선거 국면에서 부산 북갑이 최대 격전지로 떠오르고 있다. 하정우 더불어민주당, 박민식 국민의힘, 한동훈 무소속 후보 누구도 뚜렷한 독주 체제를 구축하지 못하면서 3자 구도가 공고해지는 모습이다. 10~11일 북갑 지역에서 만난 시민들의 선거 결과 예측도 엇갈렸다. 지난 1∼3일 에스비에스(SBS)-입소스가 실시한 지지도 조사(전화면접 방식)에선 하 후보 38%, 박 후보 26%, 한 후보 21%였고, 같은 기간 부산문화방송(MBC)-한길리서치 조사(자동응답 방식)에서는 하 후보 34.3%, 한 후보 33.5%, 박 후보 21.5%로 집계되는 등 여론조사 판세도 단정하기 어려운 상황이다.(자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조))

item.title: President Lee Criticizes Private Bad Banks: "Such Primitive Predatory Finance Still Exists" (이 대통령 “아직도 이런 원시적 약탈 금융이”…민간 배드뱅크 비판)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung criticized private bad banks on the 12th, saying, "I didn't realize that such primitive predatory finance was still thriving and tightening the noose around ordinary people's necks." (이재명 대통령이 12일 “아직도 이런 원시적 약탈금융이 버젓이 살아남아 서민들의 목줄을 죄고 있는 줄 몰랐다”라며 민간 배드뱅크를 비판했다.)

President Lee shared a Kyunghyang Shinmun article titled "A 10 Million Won Debt Becomes 44 Million Won; Debt Adjustment Difficult Until Death... Banks Also Hide in the Shadow of 'Sangnoksu'" on X (formerly Twitter) and made these remarks. (이 대통령은 이날 엑스(X·옛 트위터)에 ‘1000만원 빚이 4400만원으로, 죽기 전엔 빚 조정 어려워…은행도 상록수 그늘에 숨었다’란 제목의 경향신문 기사를 공유하며 이렇게 말했다. )

The article reported that Sangnoksu, a private bad bank created in the early 2000s to address the "credit card crisis," refused to cooperate after receiving a request to sell its long-term delinquent bonds to the government-run bad bank, the "New Start Fund" (operated by the Korea Asset Management Corporation). As a result, as of the end of last year, delinquent bonds for 90,000 people (worth about 700 billion won) eligible for the current administration's "debt relief" conditions were excluded from support. It was also pointed out that this bad bank, a special purpose company established by major domestic banks and credit card companies, had distributed about 42 billion won in dividends to these companies over the past five years. (2000년대 초 ‘카드 대란 사태’를 수습하기 위해 만들어진 민간 배드뱅크 ‘상록수’가 올해 장기 연체채권을 정부 배드뱅크 ‘새도약기금’(한국자산관리공사 운용)에 매각하라는 협조 요청을 받고도 참여하지 않으면서, 지난해 말 기준 현 정부의 ‘빚 탕감’ 조건에 해당하는 9만명의 연체 채권(7000억원 상당)이 지원 대상에서 빠졌다는 보도였다. 이 배드뱅크는 국내 대형 은행·카드가 설립한 특수목적법인으로 각 회사가 최근 5년간 420억원 가량을 배당받았다는 사실도 지적됐다.)

The New Start Fund, which writes off long-term delinquent debts of 50 million won or less that are over seven years old, was established after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration as part of inclusive finance to reduce the economic burden on vulnerable groups. The institutional financial companies that are major shareholders of Sangnoksu are also signatories to the New Start Fund agreement. ( 7년 이상 5천만원 이하의 장기연체 채무를 소각하는 새도약기금은 이재명 정부 출범 뒤 취약 계층의 경제적 부담을 줄이기 위한 포용적 금융의 일환으로 설립됐다. 상록수의 주요 주주인 제도권 금융사들은 새도약기금의 협약사이기도 하다. )

President Lee questioned, "Why haven't the relevant authorities even discovered such injustice until now?" and added, "I will seek a solution at today's cabinet meeting. I sincerely thank you for the report." He continued, "There is a limit to economic activities or corporate profit-making. No matter how much money is king, these are our neighbors in the community we must live together in—excess is as bad as deficiency." (이 대통령은 “지금까지 관할 당국은 왜 이런 부조리를 발견조차 못 하고 있었을까요”라고 되물으며 “오늘 국무회의에서 해결방안을 찾아보겠다. 보도에 진심으로 감사드린다”고 했다. 이 대통령은 그러면서 “경제활동이나 기업의 수익활동에도 정도가 있다. 아무리 돈이 최고라지만 함께 살아가야 할 공동체 안의 우리 이웃인데 과유불급”이라고 덧붙였다.)

President Lee had previously pointed out at a cabinet meeting on the 6th, "Financial institutions are quasi-public institutions. The idea that making money is everything and that is the purpose of their existence is itself a problem. Inclusive finance is the duty of financial institutions." (이 대통령은 지난 6일 열린 국무회의에서도 “금융기관은 준공공기관”이라며 “금융기관들이 돈 버는 게 능사라는 것, 그것이 금융기관의 존립 목적이라는 것 자체가 문제다. 포용 금융은 금융기관의 의무”라고 지적한 바 있다.)

item.title: Cheong Wa Dae policy chief floats "AI national dividend"... “Excess profits should be returned to all citizens” (‘AI 국민 배당금’ 띄운 청 정책실장…“초과이윤 전 국민에 환원돼야”)
item.description:
Cheong Wa Dae policy chief Kim Yong-beom stated that in the era of artificial intelligence (AI), a portion of the excess profits earned by Korean companies should be structurally returned to all citizens in the form of a "national dividend." (김용범 청와대 정책실장이 인공지능(AI) 시대에 우리 기업이 벌어들인 초과이윤의 일부는 ‘국민 배당금’으로 전 국민에게 구조적으로 환원돼야 한다고 말했다.)

In a Facebook post on the night of the 11th, Kim said, "The fruits of the AI infrastructure era are not the result of any single company alone. They arise from an industrial foundation built by all citizens over half a century. If so, a portion of those fruits must be structurally returned to all citizens." He added, "I propose tentatively calling this principle the 'national dividend.' Specific programs should be debated based on this principle." (김 실장은 지난 11일 밤 페이스북에 “에이아이 인프라 시대의 과실은 특정 기업만의 결과가 아니다”라며 “반세기에 걸쳐 전 국민이 함께 쌓아온 산업 기반 위에서 나온다. 그렇다면 그 과실의 일부는 전 국민에게 구조적으로 환원돼야 한다”고 말했다. 그러면서 김 실장은 “그 원칙에 가칭 ‘국민 배당금’이라는 이름을 붙이고자 한다”며 “구체적인 프로그램은 이 원칙 위에서 논쟁해야 한다”고 말했다.)

Kim's remarks came amid a situation where Samsung Electronics' labor union recently threatened a strike, demanding "payment of 15% of operating profit as performance bonuses." On the 11th, Samsung Electronics' management and labor held a mediation session chaired by the government at the Central Labor Relations Commission in the Government Complex Sejong, over the issue of performance bonus payments. (김 실장의 글은 최근 삼성전자 노조가 “영업 이익의 15% 성과급 지급”을 요구하며 파업을 예고하는 상황에서 나왔다. 지난 11일 삼성전자 노사는 성과급 지급을 둘러싸고 정부세종청사 중앙노동위원회에서 정부 주재로 사후 조정 협상을 벌였다.)

Kim's mention of a national dividend is believed to stem from concerns over the "K-shaped disparity." (김 실장이 국민 배당금을 언급한 것은 ‘케이(K)자형 격차’에 대한 우려 때문으로 보인다.)

Kim stated, "The excess profits of the AI era are, by nature, concentrated. Classes that already have access to productive assets—such as memory company shareholders, core engineers, and capital area asset holders—are highly likely to receive substantial benefits through market mechanisms. On the other hand, most of the middle class will only enjoy indirect effects, such as improved purchasing power due to a stronger won, limited fiscal transfers, or a certain degree of asset appreciation." (김 실장은 “에이아이 시대의 초과이윤은 속성상 집중된다. 메모리 기업 주주, 핵심 엔지니어, 수도권 자산 보유자처럼 이미 생산자산에 접근한 계층은 시장 메커니즘을 통해 매우 큰 수혜를 받을 가능성이 높다”며 “반면 상당수 중간층은 원화 강세에 따른 구매력 개선, 제한적 재정 이전, 일부 자산 상승 정도의 간접효과만 누릴 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Kim emphasized that a social consensus based on diverse and open debate is necessary to return the fruits to all citizens. (김 실장은 과실을 전 국민에게 환원하기 위해 백가쟁명식 사회적 합의가 필요하다고 했다.)

He said, "Will it go to youth startup assets, to a basic income for farming and fishing communities, to support for artists, to strengthening old-age pensions, or to educational accounts for the AI transition? These are open questions." He cited Norway as an example of a long-term national return model. (그는 “청년 창업 자산으로 갈 것인가, 농어촌 기본소득으로 갈 것인가, 예술인 지원으로 갈 것인가, 노령연금 강화로 갈 것인가, 아니면 에이아이 시대 전환 교육 계좌로 갈 것인가. 이것은 열린 질문”이라고 했다. 그러면서 그는 국가 차원의 장기 환원 모델 사례로 노르웨이를 들었다.)

He explained that Norway, starting in the 1990s, accumulated oil revenues into a sovereign wealth fund and designed a structure where the investment returns are returned to society as a whole based on fiscal principles. (노르웨이는 1990년대 석유 수익을 국부펀드에 적립하고, 운용 수익을 재정 원칙에 따라 사회 전체에 환원하는 구조를 설계했다고 설명했다.)

item.title: President Lee: "We Must Not Fall Into the Trap of Populist Austerity That Deceives the People" (이 대통령 “국민 눈 속이는 포퓰리즘적 긴축재정론 함정 안 돼”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 12th, "There are voices in some parts of society that demand austerity like a repetitive refrain, but these are essentially irresponsible calls that disregard the suffering of the people." (이재명 대통령이 12일 “마치 돌림노래처럼 긴축을 강요하는 목소리가 사회 일각에 존재하는데, 사실상 민생 고통을 수수방관하라는 무책임한 목소리”라고 말했다.)

During a Cabinet meeting presided over at the Blue House that day, President Lee stated, "It has been confirmed through research results that active and strategic fiscal management can provide real momentum to the people's economy." He added, "The livelihood recovery coupons issued last year had the effect of increasing sales for local small business owners by an additional 430,000 won per 1 million won worth of consumer coupons." (이 대통령은 이날 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “재정의 적극적이고 전략적 운용이 민생경제에 실질적 동력을 제공할 수 있다는 점이 연구결과로 확인됐다”며 “지난해 지급된 민생회복쿠폰이 지역 소상공인 매출을 소비쿠폰 100만원당 추가로 43만원을 늘리는 효과를 거뒀다”고 말했다.)

President Lee then remarked, "When thrift was a virtue, we didn't spend, we saved, we tightened our belts, but now it's an era where consumption is a virtue." He emphasized, "This is a society struggling because money isn't circulating. In such times, the government's role is to enable economic circulation through investment." He also noted, "There has been an announcement from international institutions that our actual debt, excluding nominal debt, is only about 10% of GDP. This shows that our national debt structure is superior to that of any other country." (이 대통령은 그러면서 “절약이 미덕일 때는 안 쓰고 아끼고, 저축하고, 허리띠를 졸라맸지만, 지금은 소비가 미덕인 시대”라고 했다. 이 대통령은 “돈이 안 돌아서 문제인 사회인데, 이럴 때는 투자를 통해서 경제가 순환하도록 하는 게 정부 역할”이라며 “명목상의 채무 말고 실질적인 채무는 국내총생산(GDP) 대비 10% 정도라는 국제기관의 발표도 있었다. 다른 어느 나라보다 국가채무 구조가 우량하다는 것”이라고 강조했다.)

President Lee stressed that actively using fiscal policy to boost economic growth and GDP itself would enlarge the denominator, thereby actually lowering the national debt ratio. He said, "If the potential growth rate and actual growth are enhanced, the tax revenue base expands, and the debt ratio decreases over the long term, realizing a virtuous cycle that thickens the growth platform. We must not fall into the trap of populist austerity theory that deceives the people." (이 대통령은 적극적 재정을 통해 경제성장률과 국내총생산 자체를 높이면 분모가 커져 국가부채비율이 오히려 떨어진다고 강조했다. 이 대통령은 “잠재성장률과 성장이 제고되면 세입기반이 확대되고 부채비율이 장기적으로 낮아져 경제성장판이 더욱 두터워지는 선순환 구조를 실현할 수 있다”며 “국민 눈을 속이는 포퓰리즘적 긴축재정론 함정에 빠져선 안 된다”고 말했다.)

Furthermore, President Lee stated, "The government should focus its capabilities on laying the foundation for a great leap forward in the national economy through active fiscal policy." He added, "I urge you to prepare the economic growth strategy for the second half of the year and draft next year's budget based on this stance." (아울러 이 대통령은 “정부는 적극 재정을 통해 국민경제 대도약의 발판을 닦는데 역량을 집중해야겠다”며 “이런 기조를 바탕으로 하반기 경제성장 전략 수립과 내년도 예산편성에 임해주길 당부한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk: "Lee Jae-myung Claims Injustice? Jo Joo-bin and Park Wang-yeol Would Also Say They're Wronged." (장동혁 “이재명이 억울해? 조주빈·박왕열도 억울하다 할 판”)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, criticized the "Special Investigation into Alleged Fabricated Prosecutions" bill pushed by the Democratic Party of Korea, bringing up "Nth Room's Jo Joo-bin." (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 더불어민주당이 추진하는 ‘조작 기소 특검범’을 비판하며 ‘엔(N)번방 조주빈’을 거론했다.)

On the 12th, on Facebook, omitting the presidential title, Jang claimed, "If Lee Jae-myung is a wronged victim, then who in South Korea deserves to go to jail? Even Nth Room's Jo Joo-bin and drug kingpin Park Wang-yeol would say they're wronged." (장 대표는 12일 페이스북에서 대통령 호칭을 생략한 채 “이재명이 억울한 피해자면 대한민국에 감옥 갈 사람이 누가 있나”라며 “엔번방 조주빈도, 마약왕 박왕열도 억울하다 할 판이다”라고 주장했다.)

He mentioned violent criminals like Jo Joo-bin to criticize the Democratic Party's bill, which seeks to appoint a special counsel to investigate alleged fabricated investigations and prosecutions by the Yoon Seok-yeol administration, including the prosecution, National Intelligence Service, and the Board of Audit and Inspection. (민주당이 추진하는 ‘윤석열 정권 검찰청, 국가정보원, 감사원 등의 조작수사·조작기소 등 의혹의 진상규명을 위한 특별검사 임명 등에 관한 법률안’을 비판하기 위해 조주빈 등 강력 범죄자들을 언급한 것이다.)

Jang shared an article where Choo Mi-ae, the Democratic Party's candidate for Gyeonggi Province governor, said about this special law, "If the investigation reveals the truth of the fabricated prosecutions clearly, it's only natural to restore the honor of those who were wronged." He commented, "The 'prosecutorial revocation special law' is now called 'restoring the honor of wronged victims.' Typical of the 'Ggaddle [Lee Jae-myung supporters] pick.'" (장 대표는 민주당 추미애 경기지사 후보가 이 특검법에 대해 “수사를 통해 조작 기소 실체가 명명백백히 밝혀진다고 하면 억울하게 피해를 본 분들의 명예를 회복시키는 게 당연”하다고 말한 내용의 기사를 공유하며 “‘공소취소 특검’이 ‘억울한 피해자의 명예 회복’이란다. ‘개딸픽’답다”고도 말했다.)

Jang also said, "The conservative mother Choo Mi-ae is back. Was she afraid of being pushed aside by stepmother Seo Young-kyo?" Following his remarks about Choo, Jang has recently referred to Seo Young-kyo, a Democratic Party lawmaker who succeeded Choo as head of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee, as "stepmother." (장 대표는 “보수의 어머니 추미애가 돌아왔다. 새엄마 서영교에게 밀리기 싫었나?”라며 이같이 말했다. 장 대표는 추 후보에 이어 국회 법제사법위원회 위원장을 맡은 서영교 민주당 의원을 최근 ‘새엄마’라고 칭하고 있다.)

Jang further claimed, "What if Choo Mi-ae becomes Gyeonggi Province governor? The Ggaddle will take all the good positions, and the money meant for residents will be funneled to leftist groups," adding, "She might lead the charge to send Samsung's semiconductor plants in Yongin to Saemangeum." (장 대표는 이어 “혹시라도 추미애가 경기도지사 되면? 좋은 자리 개딸들이 다 차지하고, 도민에게 쓸 돈 좌파 단체에 갖다 바치겠지”라며 “용인 삼성 반도체를 새만금으로 보내자고 앞장설지도 모르겠다”고 주장하기도 했다.)

The People Power Party is pushing the "prosecutorial revocation" issue to the forefront, including plans to form a "Prosecutorial Revocation Response Task Force" within its central election campaign committee for the June 3 local elections. item.title: Pro-Han Dong-hoon Lawmaker Han Ji-ah Criticizes Han: "Must Uphold Principles Even in a Hurry" Over Appointment of Jeong Hyeong-geun (친한계 한지아, 한동훈에 “정형근 위촉, 급해도 선 지켜야” 쓴소리)
item.description:
As controversy swirls around independent candidate Han Dong-hoon for the Busan North District A by-election appointing former Grand National Party lawmaker Jeong Hyeong-geun, a former public security prosecutor suspected of involvement in multiple 'torture investigations,' as the chair of his campaign support committee, pro-Han Dong-hoon lawmaker Han Ji-ah of the People Power Party stated, "There are principles and lines that must be upheld even in times of urgency." <<> Appearing on MBC's "News Today" on the 12th, Lawmaker Han said she was "unaware in advance and had no discussion at all" regarding the appointment of former lawmaker Jeong. "As politicians in South Korea, there are principles and lines we must uphold, and these must be maintained not only when convenient but also when urgent," she stated. "To achieve that, more must be done by those around (candidate Han), and that includes politician Han Ji-ah," she added, concluding, "I will try harder." <<> When asked by the host if she judged the appointment of former lawmaker Jeong to be inappropriate, Lawmaker Han avoided a direct answer, saying, "The ultimate goal of democracy is human rights," and reiterated, "I will strive to ensure healthier voices come from the surroundings." In response to a question about whether she plans to advise candidate Han to revoke Jeong's appointment, she replied, "If necessary, I should convey (my opinion)." <<> Former lawmaker Jeong, who serves as the chair of candidate Han's campaign support committee, was seconded to the National Security Planning Agency (then Korea's intelligence agency) during his time as a prosecutor in the 1980s, where he held the position of director of the anti-communist investigation bureau. During this period, allegations have been raised that he directly tortured or ordered the torture of several individuals involved in the democratization movement, including the late former lawmaker Kim Geun-tae, known as the "godfather of the democratization movement," and former lawmaker Seo Gyeong-won. After democratization, the prosecution disclosed that the involvement of the late "torture technician" Lee Geun-an in the investigation of former lawmaker Kim was based on former lawmaker Jeong's instructions to "thoroughly extract the truth, even if it means beating it out of him." Former lawmaker Jeong denies all involvement in the torture. <<> Former lawmaker Jeong also argued that the December 3 emergency martial law declaration "does not constitute insurrection." Appearing on a December 13, 2024 broadcast of the Free Constitution Broadcasting YouTube channel, Jeong stated, "It's not insurrection; this is the president's abuse of authority. The president, in his own judgment, intended to do well, but the conditions were insufficient or went a bit too far. Applying insurrection charges is something unthinkable. I believe it is a grave mistake to claim it constitutes insurrection." <<> As the controversy grew, candidate Han, in a interview on MBC Radio's "Kim Jong-bae's Focus" on the 7th, said, "He received many recommendations from local residents and holds great trust within the region. It shows that even those with a strong conservative leaning recognize that Han Dong-hoon's intent to rebuild conservatism after crossing the sea of martial law and impeachment aligns with their views." He also stated, "This is my election, not an election for the campaign support committee chair." <<> Reporter Lee Yoo-jin yjlee@hani.co.kr (한동훈 부산 북갑 보궐선거 무소속 후보가 여러 차례 ‘고문 수사’ 관여 의혹을 받았던 공안검사 출신 정형근 전 한나라당 의원을 후원회장으로 위촉해 논란인 가운데, ‘친한동훈계’ 한지아 국민의힘 의원이 “급할 때도 지켜야 될 원칙과 선이 있다”는 입장을 밝혔다.)

item.title: President Lee Targets 'Sangnoksu' from Card Crisis: "20–30 Years of Debt Collection... Find a Solution" (이 대통령, 카드대란 ‘상록수’ 겨냥 “20~30년 추심… 해결방법 찾아라”)
item.description:
<<>> President Lee Jae-myung criticized 'Sangnoksu', a private bad bank established during the 2003 credit card crisis, saying, "The card crisis was 20 to 30 years ago. How are people supposed to live if debt collection continues even now?" ()

At a Cabinet meeting presided over at the presidential office on the 12th, President Lee stated, "Is it in line with the public's moral sentiment that interest has increased 10 to 20 times and people must sell even the last sprout of a bean sprout in their home to pay it off?" He added, "If necessary, we must find a solution, even through legislation." Sangnoksu, a private bad bank, is a special purpose company established in 2003 by major domestic banks and credit card companies. It took over non-performing loans from the card crisis and has continued collecting debts from long-term delinquent borrowers. On that day, a media outlet reported that Sangnoksu's investors were asked to sell their long-term delinquent bonds to the government's bad bank, the 'New Leap Fund' (operated by the Korea Asset Management Corporation), but took a passive stance. As a result, as of the end of last year, support for rehabilitation regarding bonds worth approximately 700 billion won for about 90,000 individuals had not been provided. The investors have also received about 42 billion won in dividends over the past five years. ( 이재명 대통령이 2003년 카드대란 당시 설립된 민간 배드뱅크 ‘상록수’를 겨냥해 “카드 사태가 20~30년이 지났는데, 지금까지 (추심하면) 사람은 어떻게 살라는 거냐”고 말했다.)

President Lee said, "They are not loan sharks. Financial institutions operate using the government's authority to issue currency, and they benefit from licensing and approval systems. They must also bear public regulation and public burdens. The attitude of enjoying benefits while avoiding burdens to the end is not right." He then instructed, "We can't force it, but look into possible alternatives." <<> In response, Financial Services Commission Chairman Lee Eok-won said, "On the surface, it's a corporation formed by multiple institutions, so they claim they need unanimous shareholder consent. But in the end, profit considerations are behind this, making them passive in participating in the agreement. Since the New Leap Fund itself was a kind of social consensus, financial institutions should also participate." ( 이 대통령은 12일 청와대에서 주재한 국무회의에서 “(이자가) 10~20배 늘어나서 끝까지 집안 콩나물 한 개라도 팔아서 갚아야 한다는 게 국민적 도덕감정에 맞냐”며 “필요하면 입법해서라도 해결방법을 찾아야 한다”고 말했다. 민간 배드뱅크인 ‘상록수’는 2003년 국내 대형 은행·카드사들이 설립한 특수목적법인으로, 카드대란 당시 발생한 부실채권을 넘겨받은 뒤 장기 연체자들을 상대로 추심을 이어왔다. 이날 한 언론은 상록수 출자사들이 장기 연체채권을 정부 배드뱅크 새도약기금(한국자산관리공사 운용)으로 매각하라는 협조 요청을 받았지만 소극적인 입장을 취하면서 지난해 말 기준 약 9만명의 채권(7천억원규모)에 대한 회생 지원이 이뤄지지 못한 것으로 파악됐다고 보도했다. 출자사들은 최근 5년간 420억원가량 배당도 받았다.)

Reported by Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr and Shim Woo-sam wu32@hani.co.kr ( 이 대통령은 “사채업자도 아니고 금융기관들이 정부 발권력을 이용해 영업하는 측면도 있고, 면허나 인가제도를 통해 혜택을 보는 측면이 있다”며 “공적규제나 공적부담도 해야 한다. 혜택은 누리면서 부담은 끝까지 안하겠다는 태도는 옳지 않다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “억지로는 못하겠지만, 가능한 대안이 있는지 알아보라”고 지시했다. )
